scope: All 25 items, manually inspected before/corrected desktop-mobile question pairs and corrected answer-review pairs; final-source browser captures retained separately.
last_runtime_change: A Batch 5 dark-mode topic-badge foreground override, after the full manual light-mode sweeps. No question content or geometry changed afterward.

final_dark_retest.result: Reopened visually after the contrast repair; readable white topic text. All 25 dark-mobile labels also passed final computed-style foreground checks.

limits: A screenshot is not a live-account or physical-device acceptance test.
Wide evidence intentionally uses bounded horizontal scrolling; automated reachability tests open all equivalent data tables.
The correction rationale and every displayed value were reviewed independently; screenshots alone do not prove statistical correctness.
